title: Tomb of the Birds and the wooden bird found during WWII
place_text: Northern cliff west of Great Pyramid, Giza

tellings.quote: uh there's this tomb called the tombs of the birds.

plain: In a cliff to the north and west of the Great Pyramid at Giza there is said to be a tomb called the Tomb of the Birds, where a wooden bird was found during the Second World War, sometime in the 1940s. A researcher named Luke Caverns tells Michels about it without naming a source, and brings up the television show Mythbusters while he does. He tells it as one of the odd finds around the pyramids that, in his view, have not been properly explained.
